AI ASSISTANT × VEHICLE CONTROL

AUTOMOTIVE · AI ASSISTANT · DESIGN LEAD

ATOM · In-car AI assistant

An in-car AI assistant for vehicle functions, with conversational flows, contextual quick actions and clear sound feedback. Part of a wider ATOM cockpit experience spanning voice, touch and physical controls.

OverviewApproachScreensOutcome
View in Figma ↗
PERIOD
Jan 2023 — Jan 2026
ROLE
Lead Product Designer
FOCUS
AI assistant · HMI · Voice & sound UX

THE CHALLENGE

What needed to change.

Make in-car communication intuitive and consistent, from activating the assistant to completing a conversational flow. Define how the assistant behaves across key use cases, with clear navigation, contextual actions and feedback.

THE APPROACH

From problem to product.

Led UX for the assistant’s interaction logic, prompts, intents and conversational flows. Defined tone of voice, navigation principles and behavior across key in-car scenarios, and designed audio feedback for system states, alerts, confirmations and contextual interactions.

Activation and listening

Designed the assistant experience from the initial button press and listening state through conversational interaction.

Intents and quick actions

Structured prompts, intents and conversational flows alongside contextual suggestions for frequent vehicle actions.

Consistent assistant behavior

Defined tone of voice and navigation principles to create a coherent experience across in-car use cases.

Audio feedback

Designed sound patterns for system states, alerts and confirmations, and developed the assistant’s audio identity.

Inside the experience.

ASSISTANT · HMI · SOUND

ATOM / ELECTRIC VEHICLE

One coherent
in-car experience.

The work brought together the assistant’s interaction logic, conversational flows and sound feedback, with consistent behavior across key in-car scenarios.

It also covered the e-Mirror interaction model and the Smart Widget Panel — distinct parts of the wider cockpit experience.

AI ASSISTANT

From activation
to action.

Interaction architecture, conversational UI and contextual quick actions for vehicle functions.

Activate & listen

Pressing the assistant button opens the overlay in a listening state, ready for a command. The same button or Back closes it.

Contextual quick actions

Suggested actions include opening seat-heating settings and turning on ventilation. Frequent actions appear beside the conversation.

Conversation & feedback

Prompts, intents and conversational flows work with the assistant’s tone of voice and audio identity.

E-MIRROR

A new view
behind the wheel.

An interaction model for a camera-based mirror with multiple viewing scenes and adjustable framing.

Clear activation

An illuminated frame confirms that the mirror is on. The frame then fades, leaving the camera image.

Scene switching

The interaction model supports parking, highway, urban and custom camera views.

Adjustable view

The driver can change the scene angle, adapting the camera framing to the situation and their preference.

SMART WIDGET PANEL

Vehicle controls,
close at hand.

A contextual home screen and a two-layer favourites panel with quick access to climate and vehicle controls.

Quick climate controls

Temperature, fan and airflow controls sit together in the first layer of favourites.

Two layers of shortcuts

A swipe reveals another layer of vehicle controls, keeping the initial panel focused.

Defined transitions

The interaction specification covers opening favourites, switching layers and returning to the home screen.

RELATED AUTOMOTIVE WORK

Sound across the vehicle.

Developed sound identity principles and led AVAS design for the vehicle ecosystem. Audio feedback patterns cover system states, alerts, confirmations and contextual interactions.

THE OUTCOME

AI

Vehicle function control

Established a structured foundation for voice and sound interaction, making communication clearer and more consistent from a button press to a complete conversational flow.
